newsitem.title: GERMANY: Soccer-Rostock crushes Peking team in exhibition.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Rostock crushes Peking team in exhibition.

text.p: Germany's Hansa Rostock easily defeated Guoan Peking, a top team in China, in an exhibition match on Tuesday 6-0.
Rostock, struggling near the bottom of the Bundesliga table this year, had a hard time scoring the first goal before Stefan Beinlich converted a penalty kick in the 42nd minute.
But Rostock turned the slim 1-0 lead after the first half into an easy win with five second half goals.
Enrique Roever scored in the 53rd, followed by Tony Miecevski (63rd and 82nd) while Sergei Barbarez (71st and 79th) added another pair of goals.
Peking, the China cup champions, are on a tour of Europe and had previously lost to Napoli 3-1.
